clearAllData.description: This will permanently delete all groups, saved sessions, and settings. This cannot be undone.
clearAllData.description_kept: This will permanently delete all groups, saved sessions, and settings. This cannot be undone. Automatic backups stored in your account are kept, and you can bring them back from Settings → Data.

resetEncryption.title: Reset Encryption Passphrase
resetEncryption.description: This cannot be undone. All synced groups, sessions, and notes encrypted under your current passphrase will become permanently inaccessible. You'll set up a new passphrase and start syncing fresh.
